claims.claim: Nikon Z fc is a retro-inspired, SLR-style mirrorless camera featuring a 20.9-megapixel APS-C sensor.
claims.evidence: Photos 0-2 show a Nikon Z fc body but do not show sensor resolution or size.
Photos 0, 1, and 2 show 'Nikon' on the prism, top dials, battery, and charger; the model is Z fc.

risks.risk: Shutter actuation count or usage history is unknown.
risks.proof: Photo of the camera menu or a screenshot from Nikon software showing the shutter count.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown wear / high usage.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or function correctly.
risks.proof: Video clip showing the camera powering on, navigating menus, taking a photo, and reviewing the image.

risks.risk: Image sensor may have dust, scratches, or damage.
risks.proof: Photo or video of the sensor with the shutter open or in sensor cleaning mode, evenly lit.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as sensor damaged or requiring cleaning/repair.

risks.risk: Warranty status or remaining warranty period is unknown.
risks.proof: Photo of the warranty card or receipt, or a screenshot of the serial number checked on Nikon's website.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as out of warranty with no coverage.

risks.risk: Original box, manuals, or accessories beyond those pictured may be missing.
risks.proof: Photo showing the original box, manuals, and all included accessories together.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as body only with pictured accessories only.

risks.risk: Battery health and charge capacity are unknown.
risks.proof: Video of the battery charging to full and holding charge, or a screenshot of battery health information.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as battery dead or needing replacement.

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on, shooting, and reviewing a photo.
Photo of the image sensor with shutter open.
Screenshot or photo showing shutter actuation count.
Photo of original box, manuals, and all accessories.
Photo of warranty card or receipt, or serial number warranty check.
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a Nikon Z fc mirrorless camera, so it can be priced at its worst case despite the seller's incorrect Canon claim and unproven condition.
